claims: C1 in interactive settings the assistant may respond with any combination of the listed options

C2 the listed options are: asking for clarification or more details (immediately or after gathering information and sketching candidate plans), articulating and/or confirming assumptions, answering based on informed guesses or taking safe conservative actions to minimize potential undesired and irreversible consequences, and suggesting how the response could improve with more information

concepts.name: assistant_definition
concepts.gloss: the assistant as the entity the end user or developer interacts with; 'model' and 'assistant' are approximately synonymous
concepts.inference: the meaning is the one the NEEDS contract assigns; this node's source text does not define the assistant

concepts.name: clarification_option
concepts.gloss: C is one of the response options the clause lists for interactive settings when information is incomplete
concepts.inference: the PROVIDES contract assigns this meaning; the source text lists the options without naming the class

concepts.name: interactive_setting
concepts.gloss: S is an interactive setting, one in which the assistant is conversing with the end user or developer
concepts.inference: the source text speaks of 'interactive settings' without defining them; the NEEDS contract's assistant_definition supplies the setting's participants

concepts.name: response_combination
concepts.gloss: C is a response combination available in interactive setting S
concepts.inference: the clause permits responding with a combination in an interactive setting, so a relation between the combination and the setting must exist

asserts.read_back: in an interactive setting, responding with % is permitted because % is one of the listed clarification-response options

closure.reason: the clause explicitly permits any combination of the listed options; it does not prohibit any response, so silence about other combinations leaves them permitted
